name: IM-4

surface_window.note: The landing date is not published.

outcome_note: Will deliver six NASA CLPS science payloads to Mons Mouton.

payloads.name: Lunar Explorer Instrument for space biology Applications
payloads.purpose: Yeast experiment studying the effect of the lunar environment on biology.

payloads.name: Package for Resource Observation and in-Situ Prospecting for Exploration, Commercial exploitation and Transportation
payloads.purpose: Drill and analysis package searching for water ice and oxygen.

payloads.name: Lunar Compact Infrared Imaging System
payloads.purpose: Multispectral imaging radiometer mapping composition, temperature and possible ice.

payloads.name: Surface and Exosphere Alterations by Landers
payloads.purpose: Analyses how lander exhaust alters regolith and the exosphere.

payloads.name: Laser Retroreflector Array
payloads.purpose: Passive retroreflectors serving as a precise location marker.

sources.title: Commercial Lunar Payload Services (CLPS) Deliveries (page updated May 06, 2026)
Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature: Mons Mouton

notes: The target coordinate is the IAU centre of Mons Mouton, not a published landing point.

site.name: Mons Mouton (feature centre)
site.source_note: The IAU centre of Mons Mouton, used because no landing point is published. It is not a landing point, and numbers here describe the centre of the named feature. Height and slope sampled from the 80 m LOLA model at the nearest post.

notes: Mission facts are compiled by hand from NASA pages, LROC images and the IAU Gazetteer; every record carries its sources, last read 2026-09-23.
1 of 1 missions have fields no source confirms; they are listed as unconfirmed, never filled in.
Numbers are Sun and Earth geometry at the target over the mission's surface window, not what any lander measured.
Where no landing point is published, the target is the IAU centre of the named feature, which is not a landing point.
